name: create zero-byte files for all leaf entries in the listing
definition: Instantiate every file entry from the listing as an empty file (no content), leaving only the structure behind.
failure_mode: Missing or misplaced leaf files change the regenerated listing

name: debug a target by binary-searching a prefix oracle (even probing its size) under a strict call budget
definition: debug a target by binary-searching a prefix oracle (even probing its size) under a strict call budget
failure_mode: Wrong or missing line count fails the equality check with the oracle value.

name: debug and fix a release-mode custom memory-heap crash in C source
definition: Identify the allocator/heap fault exposed by the release build and fix only the editable source so release exits cleanly.
failure_mode: Wrong fix leaves the crash, and touching protected files fails integrity.

name: decode a base64 filename back to the original name
definition: Take the base64 segment of an obfuscated filename and decode it to recover the intended original file name.
failure_mode: Wrong decode step yields filenames that do not match the expected set.
